about: Text ornaments on the Wallet card (src/lib/appleWallet.ts). label = beside each label. code = the ornament in the line under the QR. caption = the words there, beside the member code (captionOnly true = the words alone, code on the back). layout single = one centred line under the picture (the gift, or welcome), with row above it; the member's name is on the back. Without layout single, row + welcome make a second row and the card uses Apple's ticket layout. Saad, 2026-11-27.
